case_title: Raju & Anr. v. State of Haryana
offence_finally_established: IPC s.304 (Part I) read with s.34 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused persons assaulted the deceased during a conflict that arose from a previous incident where the deceased misbehaved with women at a marriage ceremony. The deceased was chased and surrounded by the accused persons near the house of one Om Prakash. The accused persons inflicted fatal injuries on the deceased with knives, resulting in his death. The prosecution case was that the deceased was chased and held by the accused persons, leading to the fatal injuries. The evidence included eyewitness accounts and medical reports indicating the cause of death was shock and haemorrhage due to multiple injuries.
